documented_probe: C-07c78691 (evaluate a trained policy deterministically under a fixed-seed environment; min difficulty hard): the task requires loading a nested torch checkpoint into a strict state dict and reproducing an exact seeded reward-collection loop (observation draw ordering, float32 cast, argmax tie-breaking) that must agree with an independent reference to 1e-9 and be byte-identical across reruns. Three hidden cases with distinct seeds/dims/trial counts and a degenerate act_dim=1 case probe the generalization.
notes: Single-stage: load the trained model, run the fixed-seed env stream, compute the stable mean reward. Hard floor comes from the exact determinism contract (wrong seeding order, dtype, or eval-mode mistakes diverge from the reference) and hidden-case generalization over checkpoints. Rubric weights reasoning_depth, hidden_case_generalization and quantitative_correctness; no tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
